content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Insurer earning premiums and underwriting risk; GAMCO earns fees on managed client assets."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Tax, valuation and advisory services firm; no investment management or fund business."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage earning carrier commissions; GAMCO manages investment portfolios for fees."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Investment manager earning AUM fees via funds and separate accounts sold to institutions and individuals, like GAMCO."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Mutual fund and separate account manager earning advisory fees on assets managed, closely matching GAMCO."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Annuity and life insurer earning investment income on policyholder funds; not an asset manager."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Institutional asset manager earning management and performance fees via funds and separate accounts, similar to GAMCO."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Health savings account administrator and benefits platform; fee income comes from account administration, not investment management."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Operates OTC trading venues and market data services; no portfolio management or fund business."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Fee-based investment manager running separately managed accounts and pooled funds, comparable to GAMCO's model."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Financial software and outsourced back-office provider; does not manage investment portfolios for fees."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Property and construction manager for REITs; despite advisory fees, it does not run investment funds or accounts."},{"label":"C13","good":true,"reason":"Multi-boutique asset manager earning fees on funds and separate accounts sold via advisers and institutions, like GAMCO."}]}
